title: Intake outputs
description: The documents written by `harness intake` besides read-log.json, and by `harness read-structure` on top of them, told apart by `kind`: 'inventory' (inventory.json: one row per input file plus a summary), 'questions' (questions.json from intake, structure-questions.json from read-structure, callouts-questions.json from callouts, grid-system-questions.json from grid-system, reader-questions.json from harness ask (the drawing-reader agent: one question per code, blocking flag, file and where, one ref each): the open questions for the engineer, one per code and file, each with its stable key, its id from question-registry.json and its answer from answers.json) and 'structure_summary' (structure-summary.json: what read-structure extracted per file). None of the documents contains timestamps, durations or temporary paths: the same input folder, registry and answers give byte-identical documents. Paths are relative: file paths to the input folder, probe and converted paths to the work folder.

inventory_file.description: Every property is always present. null means 'not available for this file' (for example no probe for a PDF), which is different from an empty list or 0 ('read, none found').

path.description: POSIX path relative to the input folder.

sha256.description: Hash of the input file itself.

format.description: Detected from the bytes (detect_file), not the extension. 'pdf' is not yet split into vector/scan/mixed; read-log.json records it as pdf_mixed because that enum has no undetermined value.

dwg_version.description: Header version string, e.g. 'AC1032'. Null unless format is dwg.

converter.description: Tool that produced the DXF that was probed: 'none' for a DXF supplied as such; null when no DXF was probed (conversion failed, or not a CAD file).

confidence_cap.description: Same as max_confidence in read-log.json: the most restrictive of the conversion cap and the probe's file cap. Null when the file was not read.

outcome.description: As in read-log.json. 'partial': conversion partial (empty layouts) or with converter ERROR lines, or probe status 'partial'. 'unreadable': conversion or DXF open failed, or no reader exists yet for the format.

value.description: Declared by the DXF header, never confirmed. 'unknown' also when the probe could not compute units.

flags.description: Every units_* question code the probe raised for this file, sorted (units_confirm, units_unknown, units_conflict, units_suspect), plus 'units_not_read' when the probe could not compute the units section.

units.description: Null when no DXF was probed or the probe could not open it.

layouts.description: Layout names in the probe's order (model space first).

text_encoding_hints.description: Text styles that look like a legacy Vietnamese font (encoding.font_hint, or an approved knowledge-table row). A hint, not a fact; one row per style.

dimension_override_differs.description: True number of dimensions whose typed-over text differs from the geometry (not capped by the probe's row or question limits).

probe.description: dxf-probe document, relative to the work folder: probe/<path>.json.

text_index.description: text-index document, relative to the work folder: text/<path>.json. Null when no DXF was probed or the text index could not be computed.

anyOf.description: Summary of the text index of this file.

entries.description: Text entries indexed (summary.total_entries of the text index).

by_encoding_used.description: Entries per decode.encoding_used (unicode, tcvn3, vni, unknown, mixed); encodings with no entry are absent.

low_confidence.description: Entries with confidence 'low' (unknown encoding with non-ASCII text, uncertain case, unmapped characters...).

text.description: Null when no DXF was probed or the text index could not be computed.

converted.description: DXF produced from a DWG, relative to the work folder: converted/<path with .dxf>.

anyOf.description: Converter stderr signals of a successful conversion (ADR-0005 addendum).

conversion.description: Null unless a DWG was converted to a DXF.

stale_answers.description: Every answer in answers.json whose status is 'stale' after this run (kept, never re-bound): the engineer must answer these questions again. Derived from answers.json, so a rerun on the same input gives the same list.

question_id.description: The id the question had when it was answered (now obsolete).

changes.description: The input folder compared with the previous inventory.json of the same work folder, by sha256 per path; all three lists are empty on the first run in a work folder (nothing to compare) and when nothing changed, so rerunning intake on the same input gives the same inventory. Answers whose question is about a removed or changed file become 'stale' in answers.json (kept, never re-bound).

added.description: Sorted paths not in the previous inventory.

removed.description: Sorted paths of the previous inventory that are gone.

changed.description: Sorted paths present in both with a different sha256.

structure_summary.description: structure-summary.json written by `harness read-structure`: one row per inventory file, in the inventory's order (sorted by path). Every property of a row is always present; null means 'not available' (a skipped file has no extraction). The full results are in the files named in `outputs`; this is the overview a skill reads first. Counts are true counts; the lists are capped (families 100, levels 100) and say so.

inventory_sha256.description: Hash of the inventory.json bytes this was built from. Intake does not clear the structure files when it reruns: a different hash means this document is stale.

path.description: As in inventory.json: relative to the input folder.

sha256.description: Hash of the input file, as in inventory.json.

reason.description: Why the file was skipped (not a DXF/DWG, no DXF produced, DXF did not open, no text index); null when processed.

sheets.description: Relative to the work folder: structure/<path>.sheets.json.

sheet_numbers.description: Printed sheet numbers read from the title blocks (sheets.json title_block.sheet_number): found vs missing, found ones counted by confidence (confidences with no sheet are absent).

levels.description: At most 100, in levels.json order (ascending value).

anyOf.description: Questions the three extractors raised for this file, before consolidation.

warnings.description: Warnings of the three extractors, each prefixed 'sheets: ', 'grids: ' or 'levels: '. Includes any extractor-side cap on its own questions.

grid_family.description: One grid family (grids.json) with its Tekla coordinate-string PROPOSAL. A proposal only: relative spacings in the declared drawing unit, not converted, not confirmed; which family is Tekla X or Y is a separate question.

sheet.description: Detector sheet id of the view the family belongs to.

labels.description: proposal.labels: space separated, '?' for an axis with no label (built from the axes when there is no proposal).

coordinates.description: proposal.coordinates, Tekla style: '0 3*6000 4500'. Null for a family of one axis (grids.json has no proposal for it).

unit.description: Declared header unit, NOT confirmed. Null when there is no proposal.

confidence.description: The lowest confidence among the family's axes and spacing values.

complete.description: proposal.complete: false when a label is missing, duplicated or mixed, an axis is skewed or low confidence. Null when there is no proposal.

count.description: Candidates (text occurrences) with this value, on all sheets of the file.

questions.description: One question per code, blocking flag and file. questions.json (intake) order: units_confirm_all; probe question codes (blocking first, then by code); encoding_unknown_non_ascii; conversion_empty, converter_errors, read_failed, no_reader_implemented; inside a code by file. structure-questions.json and callouts-questions.json order: blocking first, then by code, then by file. Ids come from question-registry.json (one counter for the three documents, never reused), so they are NOT necessarily ascending in this order: a rerun keeps the id of every unchanged question and appends new ids. Engineer-facing text is English here; the Vietnamese rendering is a later reporter step.

answered.description: Questions that have an active answer.

blocking_open.description: Blocking questions WITHOUT an active answer: what still stops the process.

question.description: One question per code, blocking flag and file (file null for a question about the whole project), listing the places it applies to. Probe question codes, encoding_unknown_non_ascii and callout / structure questions list at most 50 refs (10 per member mark prefix): then truncated is true and count is the true total; an extractor that capped its own questions per code says so in its warnings (kept in structure-summary.json), so count can still be below the true number of occurrences in that case. encoding_unknown_non_ascii (non-blocking) has one ref per text style that holds non-ASCII text of unknown encoding, built from the text index; font_encoding_proposed (non-blocking) is a probe question: one ref per proposed knowledge row, its evidence in 'found'. units_confirm_all (one ref: the file's header units) replaces the non-blocking units_confirm probe question, which is therefore not repeated. `key` is the stable identity (question-registry): sha256 over code, file, the file's sha256 and the canonical sorted refs (where, found, sheet), first 16 hex. `answer` is the active answer from answers.json, or null.

file.description: Path relative to the input folder; null for a question about the whole project.

count.description: Total number of refs, including any not listed.

truncated.description: True when count is greater than the number of refs listed.

subjects.description: callouts-questions.json only: what the refs are about when one question covers several things. callout_ambiguous: one per notation (name = notation id); member_mark_prefix_meaning: one per prefix (name = prefix), the answer's `values` keys.

examples.description: member_mark_prefix_meaning: the most frequent marks of the prefix.

answer.description: The active answer (answers.json) to this key, or null.

file.description: Path relative to the input folder. null only in a project-level question of reader-questions.json (harness ask without --file).

sheet.description: structure-questions.json, callouts-questions.json and grid-system-questions.json only: the detector sheet id (model#01, <layout>#01; see the sheets schema) the extractor attached to the question. Not a printed sheet number.

message.description: Only when this ref's wording differs from the group's message (for example because it carries a count).

unit.description: units_confirm_all only: the unit declared by the header.

flags.description: units_confirm_all only: the units_* flags of the file.
